LAST WILL AND TESTAMENT OF ELEANOR MARGARET WHITTAKER

I, ELEANOR MARGARET WHITTAKER, a resident of Fairfield County, Connecticut, being of sound mind and memory and not acting under duress or undue influence, do hereby make, publish, and declare this to be my Last Will and Testament, revoking all wills and codicils previously made by me.

ARTICLE I — IDENTIFICATION OF FAMILY
I am a widow. My late husband, Harrison Cole Whittaker, predeceased me on August 14, 2022. I have three (3) living children: Vivienne Whittaker Ashford (born May 3, 1968), Julian Preston Whittaker (born September 22, 1971), and Margaux Whittaker Duplessis (born March 11, 1975). I have five (5) living grandchildren: Cordelia Ashford, Rhys Ashford, Beatrix Duplessis, Ford Whittaker, and Isla Whittaker.

ARTICLE II — PAYMENT OF DEBTS AND EXPENSES
I direct my Executor to pay from my residuary estate all my legally enforceable debts, funeral expenses, and costs of administration as soon as practicable after my death. Notwithstanding the foregoing, my Executor shall not accelerate any mortgage or long-term debt.

ARTICLE III — SPECIFIC BEQUESTS
3.1 To my daughter VIVIENNE WHITTAKER ASHFORD, if she survives me, I give my grandmother's diamond and platinum brooch (currently held in Safe Deposit Box No. 4412 at First Fairfield Trust) and the Steinway Model B grand piano (Serial No. 411982).
3.2 To my son JULIAN PRESTON WHITTAKER, if he survives me, I give my collection of first-edition natural-history books (approximately 340 volumes) and the Rolex Datejust wristwatch that belonged to my late husband.
3.3 To my daughter MARGAUX WHITTAKER DUPLESSIS, if she survives me, I give the oil painting titled "November Marsh, Old Lyme" by Willard Metcalf (currently hanging in the front parlor of my residence) and the sterling silver flatware service for twelve (Gorham "Chantilly" pattern).
3.4 To my granddaughter CORDELIA ASHFORD, if she survives me and has attained the age of twenty-five (25) years, I give the sum of Fifty Thousand Dollars ($50,000). If Cordelia has not attained age 25 at my death, this bequest shall be held in trust and distributed pursuant to Article VII.
3.5 To WESTPORT HISTORICAL SOCIETY (a Connecticut nonprofit corporation, EIN 06-0838141), I give the sum of One Hundred Thousand Dollars ($100,000) to be used for the endowment of the Harrison C. Whittaker Maritime Archive.

ARTICLE IV — RESIDUARY ESTATE
All the rest, residue, and remainder of my property, real, personal, and mixed, wherever situated, of which I die seized or possessed or to which I may be entitled at my death (my "Residuary Estate"), I give as follows:
(a) Forty percent (40%) to my daughter VIVIENNE WHITTAKER ASHFORD, if she survives me. If she does not, her share shall pass per stirpes to her descendants.
(b) Twenty percent (20%) to my son JULIAN PRESTON WHITTAKER, if he survives me. This share is reduced from an equal one-third share to reflect substantial lifetime advances totaling approximately $675,000 (documented in my personal records maintained by my attorney, Reginald M. Pothier, Esq.). Julian acknowledges these advances by his acceptance of the reduced residuary share.
(c) Forty percent (40%) to my daughter MARGAUX WHITTAKER DUPLESSIS, if she survives me. If she does not, her share shall pass per stirpes to her descendants.

ARTICLE V — EXECUTOR
5.1 I appoint my daughter VIVIENNE WHITTAKER ASHFORD as Executor of this Will. If she is unable or unwilling to serve, I appoint FIRST FAIRFIELD TRUST COMPANY, N.A., as successor Executor.
5.2 My Executor shall serve without bond and shall have all powers granted by Connecticut law, plus the power to sell any real or personal property without court order.

ARTICLE VI — TESTAMENTARY CAPACITY ATTESTATION
I have executed this Will after full consultation with my attorney, Reginald M. Pothier of Pothier, Halligan & Wu LLP (Greenwich, Connecticut), on this date. I am 84 years of age, have been examined by my primary physician Dr. Anders Kolbein on October 18, 2025, and received a written attestation of testamentary capacity dated October 20, 2025.

ARTICLE VII — TRUST FOR MINOR OR YOUNG BENEFICIARIES
Any distribution to a beneficiary under age 25 shall be held in trust by the Executor as Trustee, distributed for health, education, maintenance, and support, and terminated upon the beneficiary attaining age 25.

ARTICLE VIII — NO-CONTEST CLAUSE
If any beneficiary contests this Will or any of its provisions, the interest of such beneficiary is revoked and shall pass as if such beneficiary had predeceased me without descendants.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, I have signed and published this Will on this 4th day of November, 2025.

/s/ Eleanor Margaret Whittaker
ELEANOR MARGARET WHITTAKER, Testatrix

ATTESTATION BY WITNESSES
On the date shown above, the Testatrix declared this instrument to be her Last Will and Testament, and signed it in our presence. We, at her request and in her presence and in the presence of each other, subscribed our names as witnesses. We each believe the Testatrix to be of sound mind and under no constraint or undue influence.

/s/ Reginald M. Pothier — 400 Field Point Road, Greenwich, CT 06830
/s/ Alison T. Broussard — 400 Field Point Road, Greenwich, CT 06830
/s/ Kenneth O. Wharton, MD — 22 Riverside Avenue, Riverside, CT 06878
